title: 第13章 挥剑五千下第14章 无法结丹
slug: 娇娇挺孕肚死遁清冷师尊黑化了
content_zh:
好不容易找了一处山洞停下，她也知道现在这副装扮不能用了。
她使用幻术把自己变成一个普通妇人，放进人群里都不会被人发现的那种。
宁楚问了系统，得知玄华秘境明天就会开启，她打算先在山洞住一晚，明天去秘境入口蹭一蹭灵力，等到顺利结丹，她的底气就更足了。
山洞不大，但胜在隐蔽。
洞口被一丛灌木挡得严严实实，不仔细看根本发现不了。
她在山洞附近发现了几棵野果树，不是灵果，只是普通的野果，枝头所有的果子都被她打了下来，只留了几颗吃，剩下的全装进了储物袋里。
果子个头不大，紫红色的，捏起来软软的，上面还挂着一层薄薄的白霜。
她拿起一个放进嘴里，酸酸甜甜的，汁水很足，味道还不错。
回到山洞，富贵便摇着尾巴缠了上来，在她脚边转圈圈。
“别急，有你吃的。”她挑了一个最软的掰成两半，一半塞进富贵嘴里，一半自己吃了。
富贵嚼了两下，眼睛一亮，尾巴摇得更欢了。
宁楚又给了它半个，自己啃了三个，吃饱喝足，她站起来，走到洞壁前，拿出了破云。
剑身在昏暗的山洞里泛着微微的光，粉色灵石像一只温柔的眼睛，安静地看着她。
她握着剑柄，感受着掌心传来的冰凉触感，忽然想起了一件事。
在天剑宗的时候，每天早课鹤隐舟都会让她挥剑五千下。
一剑也不能少。
最开始她觉得师尊是在折磨她，每天天不亮就要起床，站到练剑台上对着空气挥剑五千下，挥完手臂酸得抬不起来，连筷子都拿不稳。
可时间一长，她也习惯了。
现在想想，那每天五千下挥剑，是她剑修根基最扎实的一段时光。
宁楚深吸一口气，走到洞外的空地上，摆了个起手式。

晨曦透过树冠的缝隙洒下来，在地上投下斑驳的光影。
空气里有泥土和松针的味道，远处有鸟在叫，一切都很安静，很适合练剑。
她举起破云开始挥剑，只是毕竟换了具身体，修为又不够，只挥了五百下就开始手抖。
可她没有放弃，而是咬着牙继续坚持。
每挥一下，手臂的酸痛就加重一分，像是有人在她的肌肉里塞了一把碎玻璃渣，每动一下就在里面磨。
到第一千下的时候，宁楚的额头已经全是汗，后背的衣裳湿透了贴在皮肤上，黏糊糊的很不舒服。
她停下来喘了口气，看了一眼手里的破云，又看了一眼自己的手臂，给自己加油打气，旋即又继续。
挥到两千一百下的时候，宁楚的手腕一软，剑尖拖在了地上，在泥土里划出一道浅浅的沟。
她弯着腰，大口大口地喘气，汗水从下巴滴落，砸在地上，把泥土洇湿了一个小小的圆点。
手臂在发抖，腿也在发抖，整个人都在发抖。
“不行了……”她一屁股坐在地上，破云横在膝盖上，整个人像一滩烂泥一样靠在一块石头上，“真的不行了……”
两千一百下。
连从前的一般都不到，却是她如今的极限。
content_en:
After finally finding a cave to stop, she also knew that this costume could no longer be used.
She used illusions to transform herself into an ordinary woman so that no one would notice her even if she was in a crowd.
Ning Chu asked the system and learned that the Xuanhua Secret Realm would be opened tomorrow. She planned to stay in the cave for one night and then go to the entrance of the secret realm tomorrow to soak up her spiritual power. Once the elixir was successfully formed, she would be more confident.
The cave is not big, but it is hidden.
The entrance to the cave was tightly blocked by a bush, and you couldn't find it unless you looked carefully.
She found several wild fruit trees near the cave. They were not spiritual fruits, just ordinary wild fruits. She knocked down all the fruits on the branches, leaving only a few to eat, and put the rest into storage bags.
The fruit is small, purple-red, soft when pinched, and has a thin layer of white frost hanging on it.
She picked one up and put it in her mouth. It was sweet and sour, full of juice, and tasted pretty good.
Back in the cave, Fugui waggled his tail and wrapped himself around her, circling around her feet.
"Don't worry, there's something for you to eat." She picked the softest one and broke it in half, stuffed half into Fugui's mouth, and ate the other half herself.
Fugui chewed it twice, his eyes lit up and his tail waggled even more happily.
Ningchu gave it another half, and ate three of them herself. After eating and drinking, she stood up, walked to the cave wall, and took out Poyun.
The sword body glowed slightly in the dark cave, and the pink spirit stone looked at her quietly like a gentle eye.
She held the hilt of the sword, feeling the cold touch from her palm, and suddenly remembered something.
When she was in Tianjian Sect, He Yinzhou would ask her to swing the sword five thousand times every morning in class.
Not a single sword is missing.
At first she felt that her master was torturing her. She had to get up before dawn every day, stand on the sword training platform and swing the sword five thousand times in the air. After the swing, her arms were so sore that she couldn't lift them up, and she couldn't even hold the chopsticks steady.
But over time, she got used to it.
Thinking about it now, those five thousand sword swings every day were the period when her sword cultivation foundation was most solid.
Ning Chu took a deep breath, walked to the open space outside the cave, and made a hand gesture.
The morning sun shines through the gaps in the tree crowns, casting mottled light and shadow on the ground.
The air smells of earth and pine needles, and there are birds chirping in the distance. Everything is quiet, which is perfect for sword practice.
She raised Poyun and started to swing the sword, but after all, she had changed her body and her cultivation was not enough, so her hand started to shake after only five hundred swings.
But she didn't give up, but gritted her teeth and continued to persevere.
Every time she swung, the pain in her arms got worse, as if someone had stuffed a handful of broken glass into her muscles, grinding them in every time she moved.
By the thousandth blow, Ning Chu's forehead was already covered with sweat, and the clothes on his back were soaked and stuck to his skin, making it sticky and uncomfortable.
She stopped to take a breath, glanced at Poyun in her hand, then at her arm, cheered herself up, and then continued.
When the swing reached two thousand one hundred times, Ning Chu's wrist softened, and the tip of the sword dragged on the ground, drawing a shallow groove in the soil.
She bent over and gasped for air. Sweat dripped from her chin and hit the ground, making the soil wet into a small dot.
My arms were shaking, my legs were shaking, my whole body was shaking.
"I can't do it anymore..." She sat down on the ground, with Po Yun lying across her knees, and her whole body was leaning against a stone like a puddle of mud, "I really can't do it anymore..."
Two thousand one hundred blows.
It's not even as good as before, but it's her current limit.
